about: Memory of BioCLIP 2's shipped device file (pub/model-bioclip2-l14 at 462ecdc, recipe hybrid-fc2-w8, 309,812,341 bytes) in onnxruntime-web 1.30.0's WASM build in Node, created as vendor/rec-worker.js creates it (one thread, graphOptimizationLevel all, the runtime's default options): the process's peak resident memory while the session is created and during the first and tenth photo, the WASM heap's size, seconds to ready, seconds a photo, on 24 test photos (the first 24 of the 320 the device runs used). Run twice: keeping the file's bytes, and letting them go once the session exists.
